description: Bare `credentials export` error lists only --to <path> or --stdout, hiding 1password and clipboard that help and llms.txt lead with.
evidence: CLI: agent-drive credentials export -> 'Pass exactly one of --to <path> or --stdout.' exit 1
suggested_fix: Mention --to 1password, --to clipboard in the error or print the usage line.

description: Clipboard backup is recorded and reported with method 'stdout', so a clipboard/Apple Passwords user sees a method they never used.
actual: Recorded the credential backup for 1 drive(s) (stdout).
evidence: CLI confirm output; credentials status method:stdout
suggested_fix: Record method clipboard when the pending export came from --to clipboard.

description: After login the terminal prints the backup hint and then a second, different instruction (set a passphrase in console under Settings). A first-timer sees two competing next steps and the backup one is the blocker for check.
actual: 'Back up this agent's credentials...' followed by 'Your account has no account key yet... Set a passphrase in the console under Settings'
suggested_fix: Print the backup step first as numbered step 1 and mark the passphrase as optional/later.

description: Approved page says to return to the agent to finish setup but does not say a credentials backup is still required before check passes.
actual: Return to your agent to finish setup and confirm it is ready.
suggested_fix: Add: your agent will ask you where to store its key backup.

description: Clipboard failure error offers 1password or a file but not the --stdout | STORE && confirm route; instruction text does not say the failure is only because no clipboard is available.
actual: Could not copy to the clipboard with pbcopy. Nothing was exported. Use `--to 1password` or `--to <a file outside the repo>` instead.

description: AGENT_DRIVE_API_URL without the /api suffix yields an unhelpful 404 on login, and with /api the CLI prints 'Ignored a different API URL returned by the server.' (test-environment artefact).
actual: Agent Drive refused the login request: 404
suggested_fix: On 404, hint that the API URL should end in /api; tolerate a bare origin.
